name: MoYu HuaMeng TG 3x3 V2 (Magnetic, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, UV Coated)
description: The MMoYu HuaMeng TG 3x3 V2 (Magnetic, 20-Magnet Ball-Core, UV Coated) is the top configuration of HuaMeng's gear-driven 3x3 — an 88-magnet magnetic speed cube built around a 20-magnet ball-core for maximum core-pulling force with near-zero turning resistance.
features: Edge tuning, exclusive to this version: 9 levels of edge-magnet adjustment let you shape the hand-feel in ways the 8-magnet build cannot reach.
Innovative gear-driven magnetic adjustment system: Each click on the gear precisely shifts magnet position, replacing guesswork with a clear, repeatable scale.
Corner magnets, 6 settings: A corner gear magnetic module adjusts all four corner magnets at once, with a tactile click at every step.
54 magnet setting configurations: 9 edge × 6 corner combinations give you fine control over magnetic feel before you even touch elasticity or tension.
Adjustment tool included: Use the included tool to set magnetic strength and elasticity quickly and consistently.
Evolved Core Positioning 3.0: The latest core architecture builds on previous generations for stronger pull and smoother piece-to-piece flow.
